packageRules.description: The LucidLink SDK is pre-1.0, so a minor bump can break the API. Never group it, split minor from patch, and let it soak for a few days before proposing it.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Pre-1.0 SDK — a minor bump may change the API.** Before merging, diff the public surface against the wheel and check `ll_core.py` in particular:
Past example: `Daemon.unlink_filespace()` gained a required positional argument in 0.12.0, and `link_filespace(name=)` was deprecated in favour of `id=`.
The file service runs this SDK behind the public gateway catch-all — see `docs/GATEWAY.md`.

packageRules.description: The MCP server pins its own lucidlink version, so it moves on its own schedule.
Web-stack runtime deps move together; they are low-risk relative to the SDK.
Management API image. Digest-pinned, so a retag of the same version still surfaces as a PR.
prBodyNotes: Both `docker-compose.yml` and `docker-compose.test.yml` must land on the same digest.
Validate on the test stack first — `docker compose -p lltest -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d` on ports 3004/8002, which bypasses the gateway catch-all.

packageRules.description: AUTOMERGE POLICY 1/4 — patch updates merge themselves once CI is green. platformAutomerge is off, so Renovate merges only after it has itself seen every status check pass (the `ci` workflow), with or without branch protection. The Mini then picks main up with docker/updates/redeploy.sh (docs/UPDATES.md).
AUTOMERGE POLICY 2/4 — minor updates merge themselves only from >= 1.0, where semver promises compatibility.
AUTOMERGE POLICY 3/4 — below 1.0 a minor bump may break the API (lucidlink went 0.14 -> 0.15 -> 1.0 with renames each time), and below 0.1 even a patch may. A PR for review, never automerged.
AUTOMERGE POLICY 4/4 — majors, a re-pushed digest of the same tag, digest pinning and anything else: a PR for a human.
Base image: take patch updates automatically, hold the Python minor line for a deliberate decision.

customManagers.description: Pick up the pinned lucidlink-mcp version in .mcp.json (uvx arg, not a normal manifest).
